note: Trigger-routing suite. expect=trigger: the skill should fire on the prompt in a fresh session; expect=no-trigger: a near-miss owned elsewhere (owner in comment).

cases.prompt: What lifecycle stage is this project in right now?
Are we pre- or post-Spec-lock on this repo?
Which of the three loops — North star, Foundation, Releases — is this project currently emphasizing?
Has this project crossed the POC boundary yet?
What's our version triple — thesis, architecture, release?
I'm orienting cold on this repo — where does it stand in its build lifecycle?
Give me the ADR/IDR/RDD status counts and whether we're in harvest-mode or post-lock discipline.
What's the state of the project — branches, worktrees, open PRs?
cases.comment: owner: harness check-state (work-state axis, not lifecycle-position)

cases.prompt: What's blocked on me right now across tickets and PRs?
What's an IDR for, and how is it different from an ADR in general?
cases.comment: owner: product-lifecycle-rules (general portable doctrine, not this repo's live position)

cases.prompt: Which doc type and sections do I use to write this decision up?
cases.comment: owner: doc-writing-rules (the live type contract, not a stage reading)

cases.prompt: What has this repo already decided or queued in its docs and issues?
What should I work on next? Prioritize the backlog.
Is this a bug or a new feature request — file it for me.
cases.comment: owner: file-bug / file-feature (this skill only narrates the Verify-stage discipline in the abstract when a live instance is in view, never files anything)

cases.prompt: Should I use /goal or /loop for this autonomous run?
cases.comment: owner: teamwork loop-rules (a different, unrelated 'loop' concept)

cases.prompt: Clean up the stale branches and remove dead worktrees.
